evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies coins database compaction and LevelDB wrapper disk checks in src/txdb and src/dbwrapper.
rationale: Prevents node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by automatic background chainstate compaction filling disk space on systems with tight storage margins. Linked issue #36585 shows background compaction introduced in v32.0rc3 can exhaust disk space and hang the node, making this a critical reliability fix for a release regression.
